label: Discount rate
Description: Annual discount rate applied to all net benefit streams
note: Convention; sensitivity only

label: Horizon
Description: Number of years simulated
note: Set by us; stated in the text

label: Producer households
Description: Fonio-growing households in the intervention zone
note: BETA: runs as broad prior until BOLDER answers. Ask BOLDER for the number of fonio households in the zone. PLAUSIBILITY (Cowork, 24.9.2026): HarvestStat v1.2 gives about 5000-6000 ha fonio in Boukoumbe alone (2018-2022); at 0.2-0.9 ha per household that is roughly 6000-27000 producer households in one commune. The range holds only if the intervention zone is a small part of the communes; ask BOLDER how the zone is delimited

label: Fonio area per household (ha)
Description: Area under fonio per producing household
note: Paper says less than 1 ha per farmer; the range is ours

label: Fonio yield (kg/ha)
Description: Paddy fonio yield under current farmer practice
note: 500-800 kg/ha under farmer practice (Kanlindogbe). HarvestStat Africa v1.2, Atacora, 2014-2023 without 2019 (identical 0.80 t/ha in every commune, likely filled): 38 commune-years, 5th-95th percentile 352-777 kg/ha, median 520; area-weighted Atacora mean 532-847 kg/ha by year. Cobly lies at 300-450 kg/ha throughout; BOLDER Concept Note names 300-600 kg/ha (internal). Lower bound lowered from 500 to 400 (Cowork, 24.9.2026). Official statistics; whether paddy is not stated

label: Own consumption share
Description: Share of the harvest kept for household consumption, behavioural reference (today's behaviour)
source_key: pers. comm. (Daniel: name, date to be added); CIRAD regional series to 2019 as context
note: Large share reported to be sold towards Côte d'Ivoire; regional production growth is consistent with more trade but does not measure the Benin trade share. Replace with BOLDER baseline (request 8). ACTIVE since v7 (Daniel, 24.9.2026): the prior of v5 and v6 (Ballogou 2014, widened, 0.50-0.95) pointed the wrong way and is now the inactive alternative own_consumption_share_behavioural_alt. Context only, not a source of the bounds: the CIRAD regional series to 2019 (ECOWAS countries) shows the fonio area about fourfold since 1981 with a flat yield of about 700-800 kg/ha; it is regional and does not measure the trade share of Benin

label: Retail price hulled (FCFA/kg)
Description: Consumer price for hulled fonio in Atacora markets
note: Nine fonio rows priced per kg: 1000-2000 FCFA

label: Hand hulling rate (kg/h)
Description: Throughput of manual hulling per woman
note: 1 kg/h in the Mali test; 1-3 kg/h in Guinea v8 (28.09.2026): also converts the hand-hulling price into an hourly wage, wage_h = hand_service_price_fcfa_kg x hand_hull_rate_kg_h.

label: Recovery hand
Description: Share of paddy weight recovered as hulled grain by hand
note: Observed processing yield 68 percent after the fifth hulling

label: Recovery machine
Description: Share of paddy weight recovered as hulled grain by machine
note: Sanoussi 60 percent, GMBF about 65 percent (Cruz). Upper bound 0.75 had no source; hand recovery reaches 68 percent after the fifth pass, so O3 can be negative

label: Volume processed (t/yr)
Description: Annual throughput of the installed processing unit
note: Cost was computed for 40 t and 100 t per year v8 (28.09.2026): throughput per installed unit; out installs out_units such units (O1).

label: Machine cost ratio
Description: Processing cost per kg by machine relative to the manual service price
note: 17 FCFA/kg at 100 t and 24 at 40 t against manual 20-25 FCFA/kg, all 2004 prices; ratio only v8 (28.09.2026): the machine fee is f_m = hand_service_price_fcfa_kg x this ratio (M3).

label: Hand hulling service price (FCFA/kg)
Description: Price paid to women for hulling one kg by hand
note: BETA: runs as broad prior until BOLDER answers. 2002-2004 levels were 20-40 FCFA/kg; current level to be asked at BOLDER

label: Hiring household share
Description: Share of producer households of type hire (all hand hulling done by paid hullers); the rest are of type self (the household's women hull everything)
note: v8 (28.09.2026): renamed from displacement_share, bounds and status unchanged. Old reading: 'Share of current hand hulling volume taken over by the machine' (share of machine volume previously hulled for pay). For every linear output the mix of the two household types with this share equals the old paid share of hand hulling (tested). Old note: Mechanism discussed in the review, Section 2.3 (Beuchelt2013: threshers in Bangladesh displacing landless women threshers; Bora2026) - not a hypothetical edge. Size is ours: share of machine volume that was previously hulled for pay

label: Time value ratio paid hullers
Description: Value of a freed hour of a paid huller relative to the opportunity wage
note: Fewer alternatives assumed for the paid hullers (declared). Screen of further groups only (account H, analysis/extra_groups_screen.R), never in the decision map. DISTRIBUTION (Code, 24.09.2026): handoff v7 gives tnorm_0_1 0.0-0.8; run as norm with this 90% interval and censored to [0, 1] in section 0 of decision_model(), because decisionSupport's tnorm_0_1 requires lower > 0; about 5% of draws sit at exactly 0 v8 (28.09.2026): theta of the behavioural reference V1 for the hullers (account H): a freed hour of a huller is worth theta x wage_h. Censored to [0, 1] in section 7 of decision_model() (at most the hulling wage, because the hullers chose hulling).

label: Opportunity wage (FCFA/h)
Description: Value of one hour of freed labour when it is convertible
note: BETA: runs as broad prior until BOLDER answers. Ask BOLDER for local casual wage rates v8 (28.09.2026): carries the preference-informed reference PREF: every hour freed from fonio work counts at this value (T2).

label: Probability of machine downtime
Description: Annual probability that the huller is out of service for a large part of the season (breakdown, no spare parts or mechanic)
source_anchor: Ibrahim Bio Yerima p. 7; Pudasaini p. 16
note: RISK R2 (d1). Mechanism only: missing spare parts and trained mechanics are named bottlenecks of fonio mechanisation (Okeme et al. 2017, Kogi State, Nigeria, cited in Ibrahim Bio Yerima 2024); fonio hullers are still being modified and remain inaccessible to most (Pudasaini 2026). Size is ours. Ask BOLDER about downtime of installed hullers

label: Throughput lost in a downtime year
Description: Share of the annual machine throughput lost in a downtime year
note: RISK R2 (d1). Size is ours. In a downtime year the lost volume is hulled by hand again, so displacement (O6) shrinks with it

label: Plan lag (years)
Description: Years between advocacy and the plan taking effect
note: Start from zero in Benin policy (Dado Tossou 2026); no sample of lags exists, only single chronologies. DISTRIBUTION (Code, 23.09.2026): gamma fitted to lower, median and upper (method = fit), because posnorm ignores the off-centre median. Was posnorm.

label: Plan machine share
Description: Share of producer households that get access to a huller through the plan's public investment
note: Assumption by decision (Daniel 24.9.): the plan co-finances hullers. Channel and size pending BOLDER request 14; switch off with ##. Renamed from plan_out_spillover_share (U7 was off until v6). DISTRIBUTION (Code, 24.09.2026): handoff v7 gives tnorm_0_1 0.00-0.30; run as norm with this 90% interval and censored to [0, 1] in section 0 of decision_model(), because decisionSupport's tnorm_0_1 requires lower > 0; about 5% of draws sit at exactly 0 v8 (28.09.2026): censored to [0, 1] in block (2) of decision_model().

label: Plan implementation share
Description: Share of an adopted plan that is funded and implemented
note: Ghana national school feeding: about 2.7 of ~6 USD per child per month reached food spending; irregular payments with delays over a year. Widened because fonio would have no budget line

label: Awareness reach share
Description: Share of producer households reached and recalling the campaign
note: Rural Burkina Faso radio campaign: 75 percent recognised spots at midline, 82 percent at endline - in clusters chosen for high listenership and at very high intensity, hence stretched downward. DISTRIBUTION (Code, 23.09.2026): beta fitted to lower, median and upper (method = fit), because tnorm_0_1 ignores the off-centre median. Was tnorm_0_1.

label: Consumption change share
Description: Relative change in fonio consumption among those reached
note: Meta-analysis nutrition-sensitive agriculture: child dietary diversity SMD 0.22 (0.09-0.36), minimum dietary diversity OR 1.45 (1.20-1.76), agriculture plus nutrition education vs agriculture alone OR 1.47 (1.10-1.96). de Brauw 2018: intake gains driven by adoption, not knowledge. Conversion from SMD to percent consumption change is our assumption; skewed, needs a distribution that honours the median. DISTRIBUTION (Code, 23.09.2026): beta fitted to lower, median and upper (method = fit), because decisionSupport's tnorm_0_1 requires lower > 0 and ignores the median. Was tnorm_0_1.

label: Awareness decay per year
Description: Annual decay of the campaign effect after the campaign
note: Mozambique OFSP: about 50 percent (children) and 55-60 percent (mothers) of the effect left three years after the end, i.e. 16-21 percent per year; anchored in own production, so upper bound doubled for pure information. DISTRIBUTION (Code, 23.09.2026): beta fitted to lower, median and upper (method = fit), because tnorm_0_1 ignores the off-centre median. Was tnorm_0_1.

label: Campaign duration (years)
Description: Years the awareness campaign runs before its effect starts to decay
note: Needed for D5; BOLDER Phase II runs about three years (Concept Note, internal) - range is ours

label: Producer price share
Description: Share of the retail price of hulled fonio that the producer household realises
note: New in v8 (28.09.2026): replaces the fixed 0.65 of the community rebuild (thin_scenarios.csv, hulled_price_realization). The range is ours; Bankole 2026 gives retail prices only, no producer margin. To be measured (field work 2027).

label: Operator margin share
Description: Share of the machine fee left to the operator after running costs (fuel, spare parts, operator labour)
note: New in v8 (28.09.2026): replaces the fixed 0.5 of the community rebuild (thin_scenarios.csv, machine_resource_cost_share = 0.5 of the tariff). The range is ours; no operator accounts are available.

label: Units installed by out
Description: Hulling units installed by the option out in the zone (programme size)
note: New in v8 (28.09.2026): the size of the programme, declared as an assumption, not a measured quantity. With volume_processed_t_yr it sets the machine capacity of out (O1).

label: Paid hullers per producer household
Description: Persons hulling for pay per producer household; converts the hullers' group total per producer household into a value per huller
note: New in v8 (28.09.2026): fixed setting; sensitivity 0.1 and 0.5 in T4 (atacora_DA_axes.R). The community value per producer household does not depend on it.

label: Enforcement of the inclusive rule
Description: Share of the operator margin that the inclusive rule actually assigns to hullers' groups under up_inc
note: New in v8 (28.09.2026): fixed setting 1 (rule as designed). T6 varies it as a ratio of the designed component, jointly with plan_implementation_share.

label: Own consumption share, historical (Ballogou 2014)
Description: Share of the harvest kept for household consumption, historical reference (survey of April 2011, Atacora)
note: HISTORICAL REFERENCE, back in v9 (28.09.2026; handoff v9 section 1): read only by the greyed-out '##' line below own_sq in block (0) of decision_model(); T2 (atacora_DA_axes.R) swaps that line in and re-runs the model on the same draws; not read in the main run. Appended as the last row so that every other input keeps its draws. Active prior in v5 and v6, inactive alternative since v7 (Daniel, 24.9.2026). Harvest share derived from a share of respondents, not reported. Bounds widened because fonio production has been changing since 2011 (commercialisation, BOLD/BOLDER activities); the lower bound allows for substantially more sales today. Source: survey of April 2011, Atacora, 200 farmers (p. 392); 83 percent grow fonio for own consumption only, 17 percent for own consumption and sale (p. 396). Widened by decision of Daniel, 24.9.2026; the Bankole 2026 data are a trader survey and do not contain this share. Documented, not desirable: a return to it is not implied
